oci_database_020.display_name: OCI-DATABASE-020: CVE-2026-21962 — HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in Exploitation
oci_database_020.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-21962: Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in contain an improper access control vulnerability that can result in unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data as well as unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in accessible data.. Product: HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in
